ModMetaData.name: RimBabel - Pickle tests
ModMetaData.author: Nelim
ModMetaData.description:
In-game functional tests for RimBabel, run by Pickle. Development only: never published, never part of the distributed Mod/ folder.
This mod is also the SOURCE MOD the tests translate: it carries a few Defs and a Keyed file whose texts are known, so that what RimBabel lists for it can be checked exactly. See Tests/Pickle/README.md.
The name Pickle's -pickle-run filter wants is the display name above, not the folder.
